title: Best Practices for Tax Preparation Marketing - Textellent

facts.fact: The vendor cites industry numbers stating that more than 98% of text messages are delivered.
facts.quote: Industry numbers indicate that more than 98% of text messages are delivered and 90% read within 3 minutes of receipt!

facts.fact: The vendor claims consumers perceive 90% of their emails as spam.
facts.quote: consumers today perceive 90% of their emails as SPAM and an average email campaign generates less than 5% click rate!

facts.fact: The vendor states that an average email campaign generates a click rate of less than 5%.
facts.quote: an average email campaign generates less than 5% click rate!

facts.fact: The vendor states that businesses following its guidelines can produce text response rates of 25% and more.
facts.quote: Response rates for businesses that follow the guidelines below can produce response rates of 25% and more.

facts.fact: A plain text message is generally limited to 160 characters.
facts.quote: A plain text message is generally limited to 160 characters.

facts.fact: Under the TCPA as described by the vendor, pure marketing text messages require express written consent, while customer servicing messages are not covered.
facts.quote: For pure marketing messages you need “express written consent”.

facts.fact: The vendor claims tax professionals using its automated texting services see client retention increase to levels of 90% or more.
facts.quote: Tax professionals that use automated texting services to implement the concepts described above see their client retention increase to levels of 90% +

facts.fact: The vendor offers a free trial of its service for 30 days.
facts.quote: try the service for free for 30 days to see how it might help your practice.

facts.fact: Some tax clients come in late January or early February to prepare returns, while others wait until late March or early April.
facts.quote: Some clients come to you to prepare their income tax returns in late January or early February while some like to wait till late March or early April.

facts.fact: The article was published on September 30, 2024.
